arm_descriptions.description: the robot looks where this one look is most likely to pay off, per unit of effort spent getting there -- the ordering every published number was measured under
the robot looks where it is most likely to find the object within the actions it has left, per unit of effort spent getting there
the same chance of finding the object within the actions it has left, weighed against the actions the plan behind that look expects to spend rather than against the walk

grading: correct = the robot committed and the place it committed to is the hidden truth; wrong = it committed elsewhere; no_verdict = it never committed within the budget
